title: Hobbies and Free Time
description: Four short recordings about free time: music and painting, sports, a club announcement and weekend plans.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Music and painting
parts.intro: You will hear Nam and Mai talking about their hobbies.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Hi, Nam. What do you do in your free time?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: I play the guitar. I practise every evening for an hour.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Wow! Are you in a band? That sounds like so much fun.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Not yet. But I want to play with my cousin. He plays the drums.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: That's cool. I'm not good at music. I prefer painting.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Really? What do you paint?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Mostly flowers and animals. My teacher says I'm quite good.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Maybe you can paint a picture for our band! I will ask my cousin, and we can all meet on Saturday at my house.

parts.title: Part 2 · Anna's hobbies
parts.intro: You will hear a girl, Anna, talking about her hobbies.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Hello! My name's Anna, and I love sport. I have three hobbies. I do them all with my family or friends.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: My favourite is swimming. I go to the pool every Tuesday and Thursday after school.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: I also play tennis on Saturdays with my sister. She's better than me, but I'm learning fast.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: My third hobby is cooking. On Sundays I make a cake or some soup for my family.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: I don't like watching television. I think it's boring. I'd rather be outside.

parts.title: Part 3 · Club announcement
parts.intro: You will hear Mr Khoa talking about school clubs.

script.speaker: Mr Khoa
script.text: Welcome to the Saturday Club! I'm Mr Khoa, and I'll tell you about this term.

script.speaker: Mr Khoa
script.text: On Monday afternoons we have chess in Room Five. On Wednesday afternoons we have art in the big hall.

script.speaker: Mr Khoa
script.text: Our new club is photography. It meets on Fridays at four o'clock, and it's free.

script.speaker: Mr Khoa
script.text: You need a camera or a phone to take photos.

script.speaker: Mr Khoa
script.text: To join, write your name on the list outside my office. The list closes next Friday.

parts.title: Part 4 · Weekend plans
parts.intro: You will hear Hoa and Jack making plans.

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: Jack, are you free on Saturday? There's a new cinema near the station.

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: Maybe. What film is on?

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: A funny one about a talking dog. It starts at two o'clock.

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: Hmm, I prefer action films. And I'm playing basketball at half past one, so I can't come.

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: What about Sunday? We could go cycling by the lake.

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: Good idea! But my bike is broken. Can I borrow yours?

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: My brother has an old bike you can use. Meet at nine o'clock at the lake.
